meta.title: PDFtutut — free PDF editor, no sign-up
meta.description: Edit, merge, split, compress and sign PDFs right in your browser. Free, no sign-up, your files never leave your device.

common.filesStayLocal: Files are processed in your browser and never uploaded
common.bigFileWarning: Large file ({size}). Processing may take a while and use a lot of memory.

home.title: Every PDF tool — free, no sign-up
home.subtitle: Edit, sign, merge and compress PDFs right in your browser. No subscriptions, no watermarks, no uploading your files to someone else's servers.
home.footer: PDFtutut is an open project. All processing happens on your device.

editor.title: PDF editor
editor.description: Text, images, shapes, highlights, drawing — all in one place

editText.title: Edit text
editText.description: Fix a typo or replace words in an existing PDF

sign.title: Sign PDF
sign.description: Draw your signature, type it or upload an image

forms.title: Fill form
forms.description: Fill in form fields, tick checkboxes and save

merge.title: Merge PDF
merge.description: Combine several files into one, in any order

split.title: Split PDF
split.description: Extract pages or split a document into parts

organize.title: Organize pages
organize.description: Rotate, delete, reorder and insert pages

imagesToPdf.title: Images to PDF
imagesToPdf.description: Turn JPG, PNG and other images into one PDF

pdfToImages.title: PDF to images
pdfToImages.description: Save pages as PNG or JPG

ocr.title: Recognize text (OCR)
ocr.description: Make text in scans selectable and searchable

compress.title: Compress PDF
compress.description: Reduce file size with minimal quality loss

protect.title: Add password
protect.description: Protect a PDF with a password and restrict permissions (AES-256)

unlock.title: Remove password
unlock.description: Remove the password from a PDF if you know it

errors.corrupted: Couldn't read “{name}”. The file may be damaged.
errors.xfa: This is an XFA form (Adobe LiveCycle). Such forms can't be filled in a browser — open it in Adobe Reader.

merge.hint: Drag files to change their order

split.rangesHelp: Comma-separated. “8-” means from page 8 to the end.
split.mergeRanges: Save all selected pages as a single file

organize.hint: Drag pages to reorder. Shift/Ctrl + click to select several.

imagesToPdf.hint: Drag images to change their order

compress.recommendedDesc: Good balance of size and quality
compress.extremeDesc: Pages become images. Text will no longer be selectable or searchable.
compress.noGain: The file is already well compressed — couldn't make it smaller without losing quality

protect.ownerHint: Needed to change restrictions. If empty, same as the open password.
protect.note: AES-256 encryption. If you forget the password, the file can't be opened.

ocr.skipText: Skip pages that already have text
ocr.note: The recognition model is downloaded once and cached by your browser. Your files are never sent anywhere.

props.nothing: Select an object or a tool

export.rasterizeHint: Covered text is removed from the file completely (it can't be copied), but those pages become images.

editor.formsHint: Form fields are highlighted — just fill them in
editor.formsNone: This document has no form fields

signature.remember: Remember this signature on this device
signature.drawHint: Sign with your mouse or touchpad
